content.title: 名词性从句(主语/宾语/表语/同位语)速查
content.intro: 名词性从句在句中相当于一个名词,可作主语、宾语、表语或同位语。判断连接词的口诀:从句缺成分→用 what;内容完整陈述事实→用 that;表'是否'→用 whether(or not/介词后不用 if);表'无论……'→用 whatever/whoever/however。

headers: 位置 / 常用连接词 / 例句
rows: 句首作主语:What caused the collapse is unknown. / That they had no metal tools is amazing.
动词或介词后:No one knows what the signs mean. / It depends on whether the rains return.
be 动词后:The question is whether the drought lasted. / The truth is that no one has read it all.
说明 fact/idea/news/belief 等名词:The fact that they vanished still puzzles us.

specialRules.rule: 从句缺主语/宾语→what;内容完整→that
specialRules.mark: what they planted(缺宾语) / that they planted crops(完整)

specialRules.rule: 表'是否':句首作主语、介词后、紧跟 or not 时只能用 whether,不用 if
specialRules.mark: whether… or not √ / if… or not ×

specialRules.rule: 同位语从句内容完整用 that;但 question/doubt 后表'是否'用 whether
specialRules.mark: the fact that… / the question whether…

specialRules.rule: 表'无论……':whatever(物)/ whoever(人)/ however+形容词或副词
specialRules.mark: recorded whatever they saw / however hard they looked

specialRules.rule: 主语从句作主语,谓语动词用单数
specialRules.mark: What caused it is(单数) still debated.

why: what 自身在从句里充当主语或宾语,所以从句会'缺一块';that 只起连接作用、不充当成分,所以从句必须完整。先看从句缺不缺成分,就能在 that 与 what 之间快速分辨。
gaokaoPoints: that vs what(看从句是否缺主语/宾语);whether vs if(or not、介词后、句首主语只用 whether);语法填空与改错高频。
同位语从句 the fact/idea/news that… 与定语从句的区别:同位语从句内容完整、that 不作成分,定语从句中关系词要作成分。

examVsReal.exam: I don't know whether he will come or not.（考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: I don't know if he'll come.
examVsReal.note: 口语中宾语从句 if/whether 常通用;但 or not、介词后、句首主语只能 whether

examVsReal.exam: What he said is true.（考试强调主语从句)
examVsReal.note: 口语常先说结论再补从句,书面则把主语从句放句首
